scientific_rationale: Women are underrepresented in cardiovascular clinical trials. The Framingham Risk Score was derived primarily from male cohorts. This case demonstrates multi-modal AI-assisted preventive health monitoring for a demographic with distinct risk profiles and symptom presentations.

lipid_panel.ldl_status: borderline — below statin threshold but above optimal

family_history.risk_multiplier: bilateral first-degree history elevates risk above Framingham estimate

medications.name: lisinopril
medications.notes: minimum effective dose; cardioprotective beyond BP lowering

rationale.APOE: Apolipoprotein E — lipid transport; e4 allele elevates LDL and dementia risk
rationale.LDLR: LDL receptor — familial hypercholesterolemia spectrum; premature MI in father
rationale.ACE: Angiotensin-converting enzyme — current lisinopril target; pharmacogenomics
rationale.PCSK9: Proprotein convertase — emerging therapeutic target for LDL reduction
rationale.LPA: Lipoprotein(a) — independent CVD risk factor; not captured by standard lipid panel
rationale.9p21: Chromosome 9p21 locus — strongest genetic risk locus for coronary artery disease

risk_scores.reynolds_rationale: Reynolds Risk Score was specifically validated in women and incorporates hsCRP and family history — both elevated in this patient. Use Reynolds as primary estimate.

monitoring_plan.lpa_test: once — does not change with lifestyle
monitoring_plan.calcium_score_cac: consider at next cardiology visit — CAC=0 would reclassify to low risk
